title: Software Engineer – Backend / Product Engineering
description: About Practicus AI Practicus AI is a Seattle-based technology startup building a unified platform for Generative AI and Data Intelligence . Our mission is to help enterprises build, deploy, and operate AI-powered solutions through a secure, governed, and open-source-first platform. Built on cloud-native technologies, our vendor-agnostic platform brings together AI applications, intelligent agents, model serving, data intelligence, developer tools, and enterprise infrastructure management. We are a lean, fully remote engineering team building products used in real-world enterprise environments. We value technical ownership, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous learning. About the Role We are looking for Mid-Level and Senior Software Engineers to join our Product Engineering team, with a primary focus on backend development. You will design, build, and evolve software across the Practicus AI ecosystem, contributing to both our core platform and the products built on top of it. Your work will primarily involve Python-based backend services, APIs, asynchronous processing, distributed systems, and AI-powered applications. Depending on the project, you may contribute to shared platform capabilities, intelligent agents, model integrations, developer tools, or enterprise applications. While backend engineering is the primary focus, we value engineers who understand the broader application stack and can collaborate effectively on frontend development. We are looking for engineers who can take ownership of features from design to production , make sound technical decisions, and build maintainable, reliable software. AI-assisted development is central to how we work. We expect engineers to actively use modern AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle while retaining full responsibility for architecture, correctness, security, and code quality. We value engineers who know when to delegate implementation work to AI, when to intervene, and how to ensure the final result meets production engineering standards. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable Python backend services, REST APIs, and distributed application components. Build product features across the Practicus AI platform, including AI-powered applications, shared services, and developer-facing tools. Design modular, maintainable, and extensible software using sound architectural patterns and engineering principles. Work with relational databases, caching systems, object storage, distributed messaging, and asynchronous processing. Develop reliable background workflows, service integrations, and inter-service communication mechanisms. Contribute to AI-related capabilities, including LLM integrations, intelligent agents, model APIs, and agentic workflows. Actively use AI-assisted development tools for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation, while critically evaluating generated solutions. Write clean, well-structured, and testable code supported by automated unit and integration tests. Troubleshoot performance, security, reliability, and functional issues in production systems. Collaborate with frontend engineers and contribute to end-to-end application features when needed. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architectural decisions. Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to deliver high-quality software. Qualifications Required Skills Strong proficiency in Python , including object-oriented programming, software design principles, and clean coding practices. Hands-on experience building backend applications, RESTful APIs, and service-oriented architectures. Solid understanding of SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and persistence patterns, preferably PostgreSQL. Experience with asynchronous programming, concurrency, and distributed application design. Practical experience with automated testing, debugging, performance optimization, and production software maintenance. Understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and secure development practices. Experience with Git, collaborative development workflows, and code reviews. Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools in daily software development. Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code, recognize limitations, troubleshoot problems, and make independent technical and architectural decisions. Strong analytical thinking, communication skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to take ownership of engineering tasks and work effectively in a remote, collaborative environment. Nice-to-Have Frontend & Full-Stack Development Experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript , or other modern frontend frameworks is highly valued. Ability to develop or modify frontend components, integrate APIs, and contribute to end-to-end product features. Familiarity with modern UI component libraries and frontend development practices. AI & Intelligent Applications Experience building applications using LLMs, AI agents, tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, or agentic workflows. Familiarity with model APIs, inference services, model gateways, and LLMOps concepts. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. Backend & Cloud-Native Technologies Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Starlette. Experience with RabbitMQ, Redis, and distributed messaging systems. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and cloud-native application development. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Exposure to observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Tempo. Understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, and RBAC. Experience building applications deployed across public cloud, on-premises, or enterprise Kubernetes environments. What We Offer Meaningful product ownership: Build and shape real software products, not just isolated features or prototypes. AI-native engineering: Work in an environment where AI-assisted development is an established part of the engineering workflow. Real-world enterprise impact: Build applications and platform capabilities used in demanding production environments. Technical autonomy: Influence architecture, technology choices, and product direction. Broad engineering exposure: Work across AI, backend systems, distributed applications, developer tools, and cloud-native technologies. Remote collaboration: Join a lean, fully remote team that values engineering quality, initiative, and practical problem-solving.

title: Middle Software Engineer - Backend (Platform)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle Software Engineer - Backend (Platform) based in Turkey. We are looking for a skilled Backend Software Engineer to help build and scale a high-performance payment platform designed for online businesses. In this role, you will contribute to the development of distributed backend services, robust APIs, and reliable integrations. You will work with modern technologies and collaborate with experienced engineers in a product-driven environment. The position offers the opportunity to take ownership of technical solutions, influence architectural decisions, and contribute to a growing product. You will also integrate AI-assisted development tools into your workflow while maintaining high engineering standards. From implementation and testing to deployment and production monitoring, your work will have a direct impact on platform reliability and performance. Accountabilities As part of the backend engineering team, you will develop and maintain scalable services while contributing to technical design, deployment practices, and operational excellence. You will collaborate across teams, take ownership of assigned changes, and help ensure that services remain reliable, maintainable, and compatible as the platform evolves. Implement backend services within high-performance, distributed systems, working with senior engineers on complex technical decisions. Contribute to service architecture and API development for internal teams and external integrations, ensuring appropriate communication guarantees, idempotency, and backward compatibility. Apply modern engineering practices, including test-driven and behavior-driven development where appropriate. Write clean, maintainable code supported by meaningful unit and integration tests. Integrate AI tools into the development workflow, critically reviewing and validating generated output. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a product-oriented environment. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and incorporate suggestions from colleagues. Document service behavior, design decisions, and operational considerations. Own assigned changes throughout implementation, testing, deployment, and production verification, including canary releases. Build observability into services and contribute to diagnosing and resolving production incidents. Requirements You bring a solid foundation in backend engineering and practical experience developing reliable services with Java and distributed systems. You are comfortable working with databases, messaging technologies, deployment pipelines, and testing practices, and you can balance independent problem-solving with effective collaboration. Proficiency in Java and a good understanding of backend architecture, API design, and scalability fundamentals. Familiarity with distributed systems, including concurrency, error handling, and retry mechanisms. Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexing, and data modeling. Understanding of microservice architecture and synchronous and asynchronous service communication, particularly with Apache Kafka. Knowledge of message publishing, delivery guarantees, durability, and idempotency. Working knowledge of CI/CD workflows and experience using existing pipelines to deploy changes. Basic hands-on experience with canary deployments and an understanding of their operational constraints, including backward-compatible changes when multiple service versions coexist. Experience diagnosing and resolving production incidents, with an understanding of alerts, metrics, logs, and observability. Ability to instrument application code and understand how telemetry is collected, delivered, and aggregated across different sources. Practical experience writing unit and integration tests, with sound judgment about what to test and at which level. Regular experience using AI-assisted development tools, including the ability to select appropriate tasks for AI and validate its output. Interest in the payments industry, particularly payment routing, retries, and subscriptions, is an advantage. Technology Stack Java 21+ Docker Apache Kafka Spring Framework 6.x Spring Boot 3.x PostgreSQL ClickHouse Gradle GitLab Benefits Flexible work arrangements: Work remotely from a location of your choice, with access to office and coworking spaces where available. Flexible working hours: Organize your schedule with a start time between 8:00 and 11:00 and a finish time between 17:00 and 20:00, while respecting team collaboration hours. Professional development: Access courses, conferences, an internal learning library, and English lessons. Healthcare and wellbeing: Medical insurance, a mental health program, and compensation for sessions with a psychologist. Paid time off: 28 paid days off annually, sick leave, and fully covered public holidays. Technical ownership: Contribute to an early-stage payment product, influence architectural decisions, and enjoy meaningful technical autonomy. Direct impact: Work in an environment where ideas can quickly become product improvements and process changes. Corporate events: Take part in quarterly team-building activities, workshops, and company-wide events. Special occasion gifts: Receive gifts to celebrate important personal and professional milestones. Social impact: Opportunities to participate in charitable initiatives and programs supporting Ukraine.
